title: CCDF: A Benchmark Dataset for Deepfake Detection in Real-World Surveillance Footage
title_zh: CCDF：用于真实世界监控视频中深度伪造检测的基准数据集

paragraphs.en: Due to rapid advances in Generative AI, commercial video generation tools can be used to produce fabricated surveillance footage that can fool both human viewers and automated synthetic video detectors. Since these tools are so widely accessible, a malicious user can create a harmful video clip at minimal cost. The production and dissemination of such videos in high-stakes settings, such as crime reporting and elections, can misdirect emergency response efforts or distort political discourse. Existing deepfake video datasets, used by the research community to develop deepfake detection algorithms, exhibit two limitations: (1) they emphasize benign web content rather than footage of possibly malicious activity, and (2) they rely on older or open-source generators that do not represent recent advances in generative systems. We assemble CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF), a video deepfake dataset, to address both gaps. CCDF contains 1,840 videos (460 real and 1,380 generated) spanning 16 crime and accident categories, with generated content produced using three leading commercial systems: Grok Imagine, Google VEO 3.1, and OpenAI Sora 2. CCDF is a highly realistic, small-scale, manually annotated dataset targeting evaluation of detection models. We release three versions of the dataset: the raw generated data, a cleaned version in which resolution, frame rate, duration, and bitrate are standardized between real and synthetic samples to prevent detectors from exploiting trivial cues, and an altered version simulating low-effort post-processing attacks. We evaluate CCDF with ten recent state-of-the-art detectors covering different detection approaches. Our results suggest that these approaches do not reliably distinguish CCDF’s generated videos from real ones, despite their strong reported performance on existing datasets. These results further confirm that existing datasets are not well-suited to evaluating certain threats. Access to CCDF can be requested by filling the form at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSmOnvIXIsAItzLosiUUpAWVnW7LeukjgODTeF4g3kv9eqJA/viewform .

paragraphs.en: The 2020s have seen a remarkable progression in the ability of generative AI systems to produce synthetic text, audio, images, and videos. The intention of such systems is to create societal benefits through lowering the cost of creating, understanding, and applying knowledge across domains like science, business, and education Bommasani et al. (2021) . This same capability, however, also lowers the cost of fabricating multimedia to a level almost anyone can afford as a video clip can be generated for little or no cost. This is especially concerning in the case of synthetic video generation given the role visual media serves in confirming or refuting accounts of events Rini (2020) . The class of synthetic media most associated with this threat are deepfakes 1 1 1 The other broad class are “cheapfakes” or “shallowfakes” which are manipulated media produced without deep learning, such as selective editing via photo editing software or mislabeling. , defined by Mirsky and Lee Mirsky and Lee (2021) as “believable media generated by a deep neural network.” Early attempts to combat this problem were person-centric deepfake detectors, targeting the detection of synthetic faces and voices Li et al. (2020) ; Qian et al. (2020) ; Cozzolino et al. (2021) as the most salient harms were then perceived as impersonation, non-consensual imagery, and identity fraud. As generative video systems developed, manufacturing or altering an event such as a crime, an accident, or an act of political violence became more feasible. The harm in this case is less to a specific individual and more to communities as a whole through the manipulation of public understanding via convincing footage of events that never occurred or occurred differently to what a video might suggest.

paragraphs.en: In response to this advancing capability, deepfake detection has expanded from person-centric methods to more general-content detectors Internò et al. (2025) ; Park et al. (2026) ; Kundu et al. (2025) , supported by new datasets containing arbitrary synthetic video Wang and Yang (2024) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Ma et al. (2026a) ; Liu et al. (2025) . However, current deepfake detection datasets have some limitations which make assessing detector performance in realistic conditions more difficult. Specifically, they emphasize benign web content like animation, animal videos, or fantasy scenes that an attacker would be unlikely to fabricate, while under-representing more plausibly malicious content like scenes depicting arson, assault, or vandalism. They also rely heavily on older or open-source generators whose outputs are often visibly synthetic and include only limited content from “off-the-shelf” commercial systems that an attacker would be more likely to use. In addition, they exhibit video format mismatches between their real and generated subsets ( e.g., differences in resolution, frame rate, duration, or bitrate) that allow detectors to exploit trivial cues rather than learning more robust signals.

paragraphs.en: Deviating from the above, we attempt to address these gaps with CCtv DeepFakes ( CCDF ), a video deepfake benchmark designed around a more realistic scenario: synthetic surveillance footage of crimes and accidents generated by frontier commercial systems with video format properties standardized to prevent shortcut learning. CCDF contains 1,840 videos (460 real and 1,380 generated) spanning 16 crime and accident categories, with synthetic content produced by three leading commercial video generators: xAI’s Grok Imagine, Google’s VEO 3.1, and OpenAI’s Sora 2. Real videos are sourced from established surveillance anomaly datasets Sultani et al. (2018) ; Wu et al. (2020) ; Zhu et al. (2024) with generation prompts derived from these real source videos via a vision-language model (which are also verified by human-reviewers to ensure correctness). We provide three versions of this dataset: (1) the raw generated data (2) a cleaned version of the dataset in which resolution, frame rate, and bitrate are standardized between real and generated samples, and (3) an altered version simulating low-effort post-processing attacks.

paragraphs.en: To summarize, our contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We introduce CCDF, the first video deepfake benchmark targeting plausibly malicious content (surveillance footage of crimes and accidents) generated by frontier commercial systems (Sora 2, VEO 3.1, Grok Imagine), with standardized video encoding properties between the real and synthetic videos.

paragraphs.en: Deepfake detection emerged from a person-centric setting where the perceived risk was the synthesis of identifiable individuals for impersonation, fraud, or non-consensual imagery. Early datasets reflected this focus and concentrated on synthetic faces produced by face-swap and face-reenactment pipelines. The Deepfake Detection Challenge (DFDC) dataset Dolhansky et al. (2020) popularized large-scale evaluation in this setting, releasing over 100,000 face videos generated by eight different methods. Subsequent work expanded the diversity of generators tested. The DF40 dataset Yan et al. (2024) consolidates 40 open-source generators (face-swap, face-reenactment, and full face-synthesis pipelines) into a single evaluation suite designed to assess generalization across families of methods. To better reflect deployment conditions, the WildDeepfake dataset Zi et al. (2020) collects deepfake videos directly from the web, capturing the compression artifacts, framing decisions, and subject diversity present in content that actually circulates online. These datasets are important for face-centric deepfake detection but are not applicable to detection of fabricated events .
paragraphs.zh: 深度伪造检测最初源于一种以人为中心的情境，其中感知到的风险在于可识别个体被用于身份冒用、欺诈或非自愿图像的合成。 早期的数据集反映了这一重点，主要集中在通过换脸和面部重演流程生成的合成面孔上。 Deepfake Detection Challenge（DFDC）数据集 Dolhansky 等人 （2020）推广了在此情境下的大规模评估，发布了由八种不同方法生成的超过10万条面部视频。 后续研究扩展了所测试生成器的多样性。 DF40数据集 Yan 等人 （2024）将40种开源生成器（换脸、面部重演和完整的面部合成流程）整合到一个评估套件中，旨在评估不同方法类别之间的泛化能力。 为了更好地反映实际部署条件，WildDeepfake数据集 Zi 等人 （2020）直接从网络收集深度伪造视频，捕捉到在线传播内容中存在的压缩伪影、构图决策和主体多样性。 这些数据集对于以面部为中心的深度伪造检测至关重要，但无法用于伪造事件的检测。

paragraphs.en: As text-to-video and image-to-video models improved, detection datasets moved beyond faces toward arbitrary video content. GenVideo Chen et al. (2024) is a large dataset containing over two million videos using 16 open-source generators and a smaller set of 4 commercial systems (Pika, MoonValley, Sora, MorphStudio). VidProM Wang and Yang (2024) is an even larger dataset (6.7M videos) from 3 open-source models and Pika Art. The AIGVDBench dataset Ma et al. (2026a) expands the variety of generative models by combining 20 open-source and 11 closed-source models in a single benchmark. Like CCDF, VidForensic Liu et al. (2025) narrows the focus to commercial systems including videos from three generators (Sora, Kling, Gen-3) but at a much smaller scale (only 1,645 videos) and with the older commercial generators. Similar to the CCDF setting, the SurFITR dataset Wang et al. (2026) targets surveillance-style depictions of incidents and contains 137K samples produced by five open-source generators, but is restricted to still images and does not utilize the current generation of frontier commercial video generators. Across these datasets, three limitations recur and complicate detector evaluation under realistic conditions: (1) most content is benign (animations, animal footage, fantastical scenes) rather than possibly malicious, (2) much of the synthetic material comes from older or open-source generators with visible artifacts (e.g., Ma et al. (2026b) reports AUC=1.0 on the Open-Sora Peng et al. (2025) generated videos), and (3) real and synthetic subsets can differ in resolution, frame rate, duration, and bitrate, allowing detectors to exploit non-content cues. Table 1 summarizes how CCDF relates to other datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 随着文本到视频和图像到视频模型的性能提升，检测数据集的关注点已从人脸扩展至任意视频内容。GenVideo（Chen 等人，2024）是一个大型数据集，包含超过两百万个视频，这些数据由 16 款开源生成器和 4 款商用系统（Pika、MoonValley、Sora、MorphStudio）生成。VidProM（Wang 和 Yang，2024）则是一个规模更大的数据集（670 万个视频），涵盖 3 款开源模型和 Pika Art。AIGVDBench 数据集（Ma 等人，2026a）通过在一个基准测试中整合 20 款开源模型和 11 款闭源模型，进一步拓展了生成模型的多样性。与 CCDF 类似，VidForensic（Liu 等人，2025）将焦点缩小至商用系统，包含三款生成器（Sora、Kling、Gen-3）生成的视频，但规模小得多（仅 1,645 个视频），且使用的是较旧的商用生成器。与 CCDF 的设置相似，SurFITR 数据集（Wang 等人，2026）专注于以监控视角呈现的事件画面，包含由五款开源生成器生成的 13.7 万个样本，但仅限于静态图像，并未采用当前这一代前沿的商用视频生成器。在这些数据集中，有三个局限性反复出现，使得在真实条件下对检测器进行评估变得复杂：（1）大多数内容属于良性内容（如动画、动物影像、奇幻场景），而非可能具有恶意性的内容；（2）大量合成材料来自较旧或开源的生成器，存在明显的伪影（例如，Ma 等人（2026b）报告称，在由 Open-Sora（Peng 等人，2025）生成的视频上，AUC 值达到 1.0）；（3）真实与合成子集可能在分辨率、帧率、时长和码率上存在差异，这使得检测器能够利用非内容相关的线索进行判断。表 1 总结了 CCDF 与其他数据集之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: Visual deepfake detection has evolved alongside the generators it targets. Early methods were face-centric and exploited artifacts produced by face generation pipelines, including blending boundaries Li et al. (2020) , frequency-domain inconsistencies Qian et al. (2020) , and facial identity information Cozzolino et al. (2021) . As generation capabilities developed to the point where arbitrary scenes could be produced more convincingly, detection broadened to more general content. The ten detectors we benchmark on CCDF were all proposed in 2025 and represent the current state-of-the-art in this setting. Table 2 summarizes them.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉深度伪造检测技术随着其针对的生成技术的发展而不断演进。 早期的方法以面部为中心，利用了面部生成流程所产生的伪影，包括混合边界 Li et al. (2020) 、频域不一致性 Qian et al. (2020) 以及面部身份信息 Cozzolino et al. (2021) 。 随着生成能力发展到能够更逼真地生成任意场景的程度，检测范围也扩展到了更通用的内容。 我们在 CCDF 上基准测试的十种检测器均于 2025 年提出，代表了当前该领域的最先进水平。表 2 对它们进行了总结。

sents.zh: 我们在 CCDF 上基准测试的十种检测器均于 2025 年提出，代表了当前该领域的最先进水平。表 2 对它们进行了总结。

paragraphs.en: The ten detectors fall into three broad approaches. The first set of approaches use features from a pretrained model for classification. C2P-CLIP Tan et al. (2025) pairs each training image with a fixed “real” or “fake” text prompt and uses CLIP’s image-text alignment to push the feature space toward better real-vs-fake separation. ForgeLens Chen et al. (2025) adds lightweight modules into a frozen CLIP network to focus its features on forgery-relevant regions. D3-Im Yang et al. (2025) runs the image and a transformed copy (patches shuffled, flipped, or rotated) through CLIP, then a classifier compares both feature sets to predict real vs. fake. The second set of approaches focus on the training data or augmentation. B-Free Guillaro et al. (2025) and Community Forensics Park and Owens (2025) train a standard detector. B-Free on real images paired with their Stable Diffusion reconstructions to eliminate content and formatting biases. Community Forensics on a large pool from 4,803 generators. WaveRep Corvi et al. (2025) replaces the low-frequency wavelet bands of fake training samples with those from paired real samples to push the detector to rely on mid-high frequency bands. The third set of methods extracts dynamic video features. L3DE Chang et al. (2025) trains a 3D ConvNet on 3D cues (motion, depth, appearance) to flag failures of 3D physical consistency. NSG-VD Zhang et al. (2025) computes a physics-derived gradient via a pretrained diffusion model and then flags synthetic videos by measuring how different their gradient distribution is from a reference distribution of real videos. D3-Vid Zheng et al. (2025a) is training-free and uses second-order temporal differences of frame features to distinguish real and fake videos. STALL Ben Hayun et al. (2026) is another training free approach that models spatial and temporal elements within a probabilistic framework.
paragraphs.zh: 这十种检测器可分为三大类方法。第一类方法使用预训练模型的特征进行分类。C2P-CLIP（Tan 等人，2025）将每张训练图像与一个固定的“真实”或“虚假”文本提示配对，并利用 CLIP 的图像-文本对齐机制，使特征空间更倾向于更好地区分真实与虚假内容。ForgeLens（Chen 等人，2025）在冻结的 CLIP 网络中添加了轻量级模块，以使其特征聚焦于与伪造相关的区域。D3-Im（Yang 等人，2025）将原始图像及其变换后的副本（如打乱、翻转或旋转后的图像块）输入 CLIP，然后由分类器比较两组特征集来预测图像是真实还是虚假的。第二类方法关注训练数据或数据增强。B-Free（Guillaro 等人，2025）和 Community Forensics（Park 和 Owens，2025）训练了标准的检测器。其中，B-Free 使用真实图像与其通过 Stable Diffusion 重建的版本进行配对训练，以消除内容和格式偏见；Community Forensics 则使用来自 4,803 个生成器的庞大数据集进行训练。WaveRep（Corvi 等人，2025）将虚假训练样本的低频小波带替换为与其配对的真实样本的小波带，从而促使检测器依赖中高频波带来进行判断。第三类方法则提取动态视频特征。L3DE（Chang 等人，2025）在三维线索（运动、深度和外观）上训练了一个 3D ConvNet，以标记出三维物理一致性方面的缺陷。NSG-VD（Zhang 等人，2025）通过预训练的扩散模型计算出一个基于物理的梯度，然后通过测量合成视频与真实视频参考分布之间的差异来识别合成视频。D3-Vid（Zheng 等人，2025a）无需训练，它利用帧特征的二阶时间差分来区分真实和虚假视频。STALL（Ben Hayun 等人，2026）是另一种无需训练的方法，它在概率框架内对空间和时间元素进行建模。

paragraphs.en: Toward improving existing deepfake detection for non-face video content, we construct a new dataset, CCtv DeepFakes, referred to as CCDF. CCDF fills two gaps in current deepfake detection datasets: (1) it uses frontier commercial generative models and (2) it depicts higher-stakes events ( e.g. , arson) rather than “benign” data ( e.g. , dog pictures). CCDF is designed as a small scale evaluation set containing highly realistic data, with each video being based on human verified description of actual CCTV footage, while limiting biases, related to resolution, duration or framerate, often present in commonly used datasets. Figure 1 shows an overview of dataset construction. The choice of surveillance footage stems from two observations: (1) people are less likely to doubt generated surveillance footage as they expect this type of content to be of lower quality and/or contain artifacts and (2) such generated footage has already been widely shared while presented as real online 2 2 2 https://phys.org/news/2025-11-ai-generated-wildlife-videos-generate.html . Unlike previous datasets like GenVideo, which contain categories such as “animals” or “plants,” CCDF contains potentially malicious content that would warrant using a deepfake detection tool to verify its validity. This surveillance setting more closely mimics real world usage likely to be encountered by deepfake detectors.
paragraphs.zh: 为了改进现有针对非人脸视频内容的深度伪造检测技术，我们构建了一个名为 CCtv DeepFakes（简称 CCDF）的新数据集。 CCDF 填补了当前深度伪造检测数据集的两个空白：（1）它采用了前沿的商业生成模型；（2）它描绘了更具风险的事件（例如纵火），而非“无害”的数据（例如狗的图片）。 CCDF 被设计为一个包含高度逼真数据的小规模评估集，其中每个视频都基于人类验证过的真实 CCTV 画面描述，同时限制了常见数据集中常出现的与分辨率、时长或帧率相关的偏差。 图 1 展示了该数据集构建的概览。 选择监控录像作为数据来源源于两个观察结果：（1）人们不太可能质疑生成的监控录像，因为他们预期这类内容质量较低和/或包含伪影；（2）此类生成的录像已经被广泛分享，并被当作真实内容在线传播 2 2 2 https://phys.org/news/2025-11-ai-generated-wildlife-videos-generate.html。 与 GenVideo 等先前数据集不同，后者包含“动物”或“植物”等类别，而 CCDF 则包含可能具有恶意性质的内容，这些内容有必要使用深度伪造检测工具来验证其真实性。 这种监控场景的设置更贴近深度伪造检测器在实际世界中可能遇到的使用情况。

sents.zh: CCDF 填补了当前深度伪造检测数据集的两个空白：（1）它采用了前沿的商业生成模型；（2）它描绘了更具风险的事件（例如纵火），而非“无害”的数据（例如狗的图片）。

sents.en: CCDF is designed as a small scale evaluation set containing highly realistic data, with each video being based on human verified description of actual CCTV footage, while limiting biases, related to resolution, duration or framerate, often present in commonly used datasets.
sents.zh: CCDF 被设计为一个包含高度逼真数据的小规模评估集，其中每个视频都基于人类验证过的真实 CCTV 画面描述，同时限制了常见数据集中常出现的与分辨率、时长或帧率相关的偏差。

sents.en: Figure 1 shows an overview of dataset construction.
sents.zh: 图 1 展示了该数据集构建的概览。

sents.en: The choice of surveillance footage stems from two observations: (1) people are less likely to doubt generated surveillance footage as they expect this type of content to be of lower quality and/or contain artifacts and (2) such generated footage has already been widely shared while presented as real online 2 2 2 https://phys.org/news/2025-11-ai-generated-wildlife-videos-generate.html .
sents.zh: 选择监控录像作为数据来源源于两个观察结果：（1）人们不太可能质疑生成的监控录像，因为他们预期这类内容质量较低和/或包含伪影；（2）此类生成的录像已经被广泛分享，并被当作真实内容在线传播 2 2 2 https://phys.org/news/2025-11-ai-generated-wildlife-videos-generate.html。

sents.en: Unlike previous datasets like GenVideo, which contain categories such as “animals” or “plants,” CCDF contains potentially malicious content that would warrant using a deepfake detection tool to verify its validity.
sents.zh: 与 GenVideo 等先前数据集不同，后者包含“动物”或“植物”等类别，而 CCDF 则包含可能具有恶意性质的内容，这些内容有必要使用深度伪造检测工具来验证其真实性。

sents.en: This surveillance setting more closely mimics real world usage likely to be encountered by deepfake detectors.
sents.zh: 这种监控场景的设置更贴近深度伪造检测器在实际世界中可能遇到的使用情况。

paragraphs.en: To generate realistic surveillance footage, we base the prompts on 3 surveillance footage datasets widely used for anomaly detection. Specifically, UCF-Crime Sultani et al. (2018) , XD-Violence Wu et al. (2020) and MSAD Zhu et al. (2024) . The use of three different datasets allows for higher diversity in content and format. We keep all the categories from UCF-Crime and MSAD but only keep “Road Accident”, “Explosion” and “Fighting” from XD-Violence as it contains many non-surveillance videos ( e.g. , from movies and news reports). We randomly select 666 videos from this set and manually cut out 20s clips corresponding to the event category. We then generate prompts by imputing the videos to the ‘‘gemini-3-pro-preview’’ model. The model is prompted 3 3 3 The full prompt used and other parameters are available in the Appendix. to extract the following information from the clips.
paragraphs.zh: 为了生成逼真的监控录像，我们基于 3 个广泛用于异常检测的监控录像数据集来构建提示词。 具体而言，UCF-Crime Sultani 等人 (2018) 、XD-Violence Wu 等人 (2020) 以及 MSAD Zhu 等人 (2024) 。 使用三个不同的数据集有助于提升内容和格式上的多样性。 我们保留了 UCF-Crime 和 MSAD 中的所有类别，但仅保留 XD-Violence 中的“交通事故”“爆炸”和“打斗”，因为该数据集包含许多非监控录像（例如来自电影和新闻报道的录像）。 我们从该数据集中随机选取了 666 段视频，并手动剪辑出与事件类别对应的 20 秒片段。 接着，我们将这些视频输入到“gemini-3-pro-preview”模型中，以生成提示词。 该模型被提示 3 3 3 所使用的完整提示词及其他参数见附录。从片段中提取以下信息。

paragraphs.en: Video Source and Technical Details : description of the footage type (CCTV, dash-cam, doorbell camera, etc .), resolution, sharpness, metadata overlay ( e.g. , logo or timestamp), or any other information that can be used to describe the footage not directly related to the action of the video.
paragraphs.zh: 视频来源与技术细节：对视频片段类型的描述（如监控摄像头、行车记录仪、门铃摄像头等）、分辨率、清晰度、元数据叠加（例如徽标或时间戳），或任何其他可用于描述视频片段但与视频中具体行为无直接关联的信息。

paragraphs.en: Background and Setting : description of the environment, location, as well as lighting and colors.
paragraphs.zh: 背景与设定：对环境、地点以及光线和颜色的描述。

paragraphs.en: Initial Frame Description : precise description of the first frame content, including people and objects.
paragraphs.zh: 初始帧描述：对第一帧内容的精确描述，包括人物和物体。

paragraphs.en: Actions and Events : description of the main action of the video as a sequence of events and the motion of the camera (if any).
paragraphs.zh: 动作与事件：以事件序列和（若有）的摄像机运动形式，描述视频中的主要动作。

paragraphs.en: Audio Description : description of sounds, noises, music, or voices (if any).
paragraphs.zh: 音频描述：对声音、噪音、音乐或语音（如有）的描述。

paragraphs.en: The generated prompts are manually reviewed and corrected by human annotators to ensure that descriptions match the actual source video content. A full 20s clip is used to create the video description instead of 8s clip as most of the events ( e.g. , robbery or burglary) tend to last longer than 8s. A truncated clip would not allow the capture of all the meaningful information from the video.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的提示词会由人类标注员进行人工审核和修正，以确保描述与实际源视频内容相符。 我们使用完整的 20 秒片段来生成视频描述，而不是 8 秒片段，因为大多数事件（例如抢劫或入室盗窃）通常会持续超过 8 秒。 截断的片段将无法捕捉视频中所有有意义的信息。

paragraphs.en: We generate videos following a two step process. First, we generate an image using the “Video Source and Technical Details”, “Background and Setting” and “Initial Frame Description” sections from the textual video description. Second, we use the generated image along with the “Actions and Events” and “Audio Description” sections of the textual video description to generate a video. We employ this two-stage approach after preliminary tests showed it resulted in higher quality videos than a direct text-to-video approach.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个两步流程来生成视频。 首先，我们利用文本视频描述中的“视频来源与技术细节”、“背景与设定”以及“初始帧描述”部分生成一张图像。 其次，我们将生成的图像与文本视频描述中的“动作与事件”和“音频描述”部分结合使用，以生成视频。 在初步测试表明这种两阶段方法比直接进行文本到视频的转换能产生更高质量的视频后，我们采用了这种方法。

paragraphs.en: In the two stage video generation, we employ OpenAI GPT Image 1.5 8 8 8 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation (gpt-image-1.5-2025-12-16), xAI Grok Imagine Image 9 9 9 https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/images/generation (grok-imagine-image-2026-03-02), and Google Nano Banana Pro 10 10 10 https://deepmind.google/models/gemini-image/ (gemini-3-pro-image-preview) for image generation. While for video generation, we use OpenAI Sora 2 11 11 11 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/video-generation (sora-2-2025-12-08, with sora-2-pro-2025-10-06 used as a fallback for videos blocked at the sora-2-2025-12-08 moderation stage), Grok Imagine-Video 12 12 12 https://docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-imagine-video (model version not provided, generation took place between 2026-04-08 and 2026-04-16) and Google VEO 3.1 13 13 13 https://aistudio.google.com/models/veo-3 (veo-3.1-generate-preview). In this process, image and video model from the same provider are paired ( e.g. , Sora 2 video generation uses only images GPT Image 1.5). For VEO3.1, images were generated at resolution 1200 × \times 896 and 1376 × \times 768 with a 70%/30% split to mimic the original data aspect ratio distribution. Video were then generated at 1280 × \times 720, VEO3.1 do not allow lower resolutions and only portrait or landscape aspect ratio. Grok images were generated at resolution 1200 × \times 896 and 1408 × \times 768 with a 70%/30% split to mimic the original data aspect ratio distribution. Videos were generated at resolution 640 × \times 480 (images at 1200 × \times 896) and resolution 1280 × \times 720 (images at 1408 × \times 768) to mimic the original data distribution. For Sora 2, images are generated at resolution 1024 × \times 1024. Videos are then generated at resolution 1280 × \times 720 with images scaled and padded to fit video dimensions (but retain aspect ratio). All generated videos for all models are 8s long, matching the maximum length that VEO3.1 can generate. All video are generated with audio enabled and feed the “Audio Description” section even if it simply described a lack of audio. More details about the settings can be found in the Appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 在双阶段视频生成过程中，我们使用 OpenAI GPT Image 1.5 8 8 8 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation (gpt-image-1.5-2025-12-16)、xAI Grok Imagine Image 9 9 9 https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/images/generation (grok-imagine-image-2026-03-02) 和 Google Nano Banana Pro 10 10 10 https://deepmind.google/models/gemini-image/ (gemini-3-pro-image-preview) 进行图像生成。 而在视频生成方面，我们使用 OpenAI Sora 2 11 11 11 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/video-generation (sora-2-2025-12-08，若 sora-2-2025-12-08 的审核阶段被阻止，则使用 sora-2-pro-2025-10-06 作为备用方案)、Grok Imagine-Video 12 12 12 https://docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-imagine-video（未提供模型版本，生成时间介于 2026-04-08 至 2026-04-16 之间）以及 Google VEO 3.1 13 13 13 https://aistudio.google.com/models/veo-3 (veo-3.1-generate-preview)。 在此过程中，来自同一提供商的图像和视频模型会被配对使用（例如，Sora 2 视频生成仅使用 GPT Image 1.5 生成的图像）。 对于 VEO3.1，图像以 1200 × 896 和 1376 × 768 的分辨率生成，并以 70%/30% 的比例分配，以模拟原始数据的宽高比分布。 随后视频以 1280 × 720 的分辨率生成；VEO3.1 不支持更低的分辨率，且仅允许竖屏或横屏的宽高比。 Grok 图像以 1200 × 896 和 1408 × 768 的分辨率生成，并以 70%/30% 的比例分配，以模拟原始数据的宽高比分布。 视频以 640 × 480（图像为 1200 × 896）和 1280 × 720（图像为 1408 × 768）的分辨率生成，以模拟原始数据的分布。 对于 Sora 2，图像以 1024 × 1024 的分辨率生成。 随后视频以 1280 × 720 的分辨率生成，其中图像经过缩放和填充以适配视频尺寸（但保留宽高比）。 所有模型生成的视频时长均为 8 秒，与 VEO3.1 可生成的最大时长一致。 所有视频均在启用音频的情况下生成，并且会向“音频描述”部分提供信息，即使该部分仅说明没有音频内容。 有关设置的更多细节，请参见附录。

paragraphs.en: The video generation process results in 657 videos for Grok, 607 videos for Veo, and 501 videos for Sora 2. These counts, lower than the original 666 videos, correspond to blocked requests by the moderation stage of the generative models when generating either images or videos. To balance our dataset, we keep only videos that have successfully generated by all 3 models leaving us with 1,840 videos overall (460 real videos and 460 videos for each of the 3 generators). To avoid trivial distinctions between real and generated videos, we provide a “cleaned” version of CCDF, designed to limit the differences between real data and generated data. First we limit the duration of real video to 8s (some videos that are originally shorter are kept at their original duration), we set the frame rate to 24 fps for all videos, remove the audio track, and ensure the video codec is the same for all videos (H.264). The cut to 8s was performed manually for all videos to keep the focus on the event category of the video. As the source videos contain 16 different resolutions compared to the 2 available for generated videos, we mirror the resolution of generated videos onto their real counterparts. Finally, as we observed a large difference in average bitrate between real and generated videos, we also set an upper bound on the bitrate of generated videos. To simulate a low effort attack on detectors, we provide an “altered” version of CCDF. The alterations consist of reducing the fps to 6, randomly modifying the saturation and hue value to alter the colors, and halving the resolution for 720p videos. The modifications are performed with FFmpeg and take less than a second to modify a single video.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成过程为 Grok 生成了 657 个视频，为 Veo 生成了 607 个视频，为 Sora 2 生成了 501 个视频。 这些数量低于最初的 666 个视频，对应于生成模型在生成图像或视频时，其审核阶段所拦截的请求。 为了平衡我们的数据集，我们仅保留由所有 3 个模型成功生成的视频，最终共得到 1,840 个视频（包括 460 个真实视频和每个生成器对应的 460 个视频）。 为避免真实视频与生成视频之间出现过于明显的区别，我们提供了 CCDF 的“净化版”，旨在限制真实数据与生成数据之间的差异。 首先，我们将真实视频的时长限制为 8 秒（部分原本较短的视频则保留原始时长），并将所有视频的帧率设为 24 fps，移除音频轨道，并确保所有视频使用相同的视频编解码器（H.264）。 所有视频的 8 秒截取均通过人工操作完成，以保持对视频中事件类别的聚焦。 由于源视频包含 16 种不同的分辨率，而生成视频仅有 2 种可用分辨率，因此我们将生成视频的分辨率镜像复制到其对应的真实视频中。 最后，由于我们观察到真实视频与生成视频的平均码率存在较大差异，我们还为生成视频的码率设置了上限。 为了模拟对检测器的一种低难度攻击，我们提供了 CCDF 的“修改版”。 这些修改包括将帧率降至 6 fps，随机调整饱和度和色相值以改变颜色，以及将 720p 视频的分辨率减半。 这些修改通过 FFmpeg 完成，修改单个视频所需时间不到一秒。

We observe that event categories corresponding to violent behaviors ( e.g. , Robbery or Shooting) were more heavily moderated and this resulted in discarding up to two-thirds of the original videos in that event category. We also observe that Sora 2 has the strictest moderation and blocked more than 150 videos. But we also note that videos that pass the Sora 2 moderation could be moderated by the other two models. paragraphs.en: We evaluate CCDF on 10 methods described in Section 2.3 . We evaluate these methods on the cleaned and altered versions of the CCDF dataset to assess how simple alterations can affect detection models. We use the following 7 metrics for evaluation, following the most commonly used metrics for deepfake detectors: Area Under the Curve (AUC), Average Precision (AP), Balanced Accuracy (Acc) with a threshold at 0.5, recall, F1-Score, Expected-Calibration-Error (ECE), Negative Log Likelihood (NLL). For each method we use the code and weights provided by the authors on their github pages. None of the methods are retrained on data of CCDF and tested in a zero-shot setting, simulating an operational setting where the detector must classify real or fake given only a video. For image-based methods, we extract frames at 1 fps (8 images per video) and compute the score on a per video basis by averaging the logits returned by the network for each set of 8 images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第 2.3 节中描述的 10 种方法上对 CCDF 进行了评估。 我们在经过清理和修改的 CCDF 数据集版本上评估了这些方法，以探究简单的修改如何影响检测模型。 我们采用以下 7 项指标进行评估，这些指标是深度伪造检测器中最常用的指标：曲线下面积（AUC）、平均精度（AP）、阈值设为 0.5 时的平衡准确率（Acc）、召回率、F1 分数、期望校准误差（ECE）和负对数似然（NLL）。 对于每种方法，我们都使用了作者在其 GitHub 页面上提供的代码和权重。 这些方法均未在 CCDF 数据上重新训练，而是在零样本设置下进行测试，模拟了检测器仅根据视频判断真假的实际运行场景。 对于基于图像的方法，我们以 1 fps（每个视频提取 8 张图像）的速度提取帧，并通过将网络对每组 8 张图像返回的 logits 取平均值，按视频计算得分。

paragraphs.en: On the Cleaned set, we observe that none of the 10 methods accurately distinguish between real and generated CCDF videos. Specifically many methods either classify nearly all videos as real or fake as indicated by the recall values, leading to discrepancies between metrics. This is in stark contrast with the results on GenVideo. This can be explained by several factors, the likely primary reason, shared by all methods, is the training data used. The training data is dated for many of the methods ( i.e. , C2P-CLIP, Forgelens, D3-Im, C-forensic and D3-vid only use generators from 2023 or before). For the others that use more recent training data (2024), the generators are open-source and significantly less effective than frontier commercial models and generate obvious deepfake artifacts. Furthermore, many methods also use real data from older sources ( e.g. , ImageNet Deng et al. (2009) ) leading to a focus on low resolution real data while the generated data will typically be higher resolution. While CCDF contains resolution as low as 320 × \times 240, which is still higher than some of these datasets, we also provide higher resolution content making the dataset more diverse and potentially more challenging for these models. Finally, most of the data used for training presents large differences between real and generated videos in term of resolution, frame rate or duration. For example, in GenVideo Chen et al. (2024) training set, real videos have a resolution between 224 × \times 224 and 640 × \times 340 with duration between 5s and 120s. Meanwhile, the generated videos have a resolution between 512 × \times 512 and 1280 × \times 720 and duration between 2s and 6s. Contrary to this, CCDF provides a cleaned set where the video properties are the same for real and generated videos, making it harder for model who might have learned these biases. On top of these, B-Free is trained on a dataset of edited images instead of fully generated which can also increase the evaluation gap.
paragraphs.zh: 在清理后的数据集上，我们发现这 10 种方法都无法准确区分真实的 CCDF 视频和生成的 CCDF 视频。 具体而言，许多方法要么将几乎所有视频都归类为真实视频，要么归类为虚假视频（如召回率值所示），导致各项指标之间出现差异。 这与 GenVideo 上的结果形成鲜明对比。 这可以由多种因素解释，其中最可能的主要原因是所有方法都使用了相同的训练数据。 许多方法的训练数据已经过时（例如，C2P-CLIP、Forgelens、D3-Im、C-forensic 和 D3-vid 仅使用 2023 年或更早的生成器）。 对于使用较新训练数据（2024 年）的其他方法，其生成器是开源的，效果远不如前沿的商业模型，并且会产生明显的深度伪造伪影。 此外，许多方法还使用了来自旧来源的真实数据（例如，ImageNet Deng et al. paragraphs.en: Overall, the benchmark shows that recent methods struggle in a zero-shot setting on CCDF. We attribute this for the most part to the use of frontier generative models in CCDF. However, the setting of CCTV footage is also important as it allows us to simulate deepfakes that would require the use of detectors. Ben Hayun et al. (2026) report AUC and AP of 0.86 and 0.87 respectively on VEO3 generated data, however in our experiments on CCDF show that even using the raw data, STALL only achieve 0.599 AUC and 0.587 AP on VEO3.1. This highlight the fact that beyond the use of frontier models, the surveillance settings footage also prove more challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，该基准测试表明，近期方法在 CCDF 的零样本设置中表现不佳。我们认为这主要归因于 CCDF 中使用了前沿生成模型。然而，CCTV 录像的设置也很重要，因为它使我们能够模拟需要检测器才能识别的深度伪造内容。Ben Hayun 等人（2026）报告称，在 VEO3 生成的数据上，AUC 和 AP 分别为 0.86 和 0.87；然而，我们在 CCDF 上的实验表明，即使使用原始数据，STALL 在 VEO3.1 上也仅能达到 0.599 的 AUC 和 0.587 的 AP。这凸显出这样一个事实：除了使用前沿模型之外，监控录像的设置也更具挑战性。

paragraphs.en: This study highlights two important points. First, the need for deepfake detection datasets that match high-stakes operational scenarios. Second, the need for more robust detection methods that can accurately detect generated content from frontier video generators.

paragraphs.en: Despite its advantage over existing datasets, CCDF suffers from some limitations that will be addressed in future work. First, while we curated the content of the dataset, we did not evaluate if each generated video reliably fools people into mistaking them for real content. Future works will include an user study to rank videos based on their ability to deceive people. Second, the size of CCDF is still relatively small compared to web-scraped datasets and is limited to 3 methods. Future work will increase the size of the dataset while including additional generative video models. However, CCDF will remain an evaluation-only benchmark and is not intended to reach the scale required for training detection algorithms. Specifically, we will modify video descriptions to be more moderation compliant without altering their content, thereby reducing the number of videos that are not generated. Third, due to generative models limitations, video length is still short (8s) while real surveillance footage is likely longer. Lastly, CCDF currently only includes 16 action categories, some of them with less than 10 valid samples which is not entirely representative of the diversity of content captured by surveillance camera. Future versions of CCDF will include more varied video length, particularly longer video if the evolution of generative models permit it and extend the number of action categories.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 CCDF 相较于现有数据集具有优势，但它也存在一些局限性，这些问题将在未来的工作中得到解决。 首先，虽然我们对数据集的内容进行了整理，但并未评估每个生成的视频是否确实能让人误以为其为真实内容。 未来的工作将包括一项用户研究，以根据视频欺骗人的能力对其进行排序。 其次，与网络抓取的数据集相比，CCDF 的规模仍然相对较小，且仅限于 3 种方法。 未来的工作将扩大数据集的规模，同时加入更多的生成式视频模型。 然而，CCDF 仍将仅作为一个评估基准，其规模并不打算达到训练检测算法所需的水平。 具体来说，我们将修改视频描述以使其更符合审核要求，同时不改变其内容，从而减少无法生成的视频数量。 第三，由于生成式模型的限制，视频长度仍然较短（8 秒），而真实的监控录像通常更长。 最后，CCDF 目前仅包含 16 个动作类别，其中一些类别的有效样本少于 10 个，这并不完全代表监控摄像头所捕捉内容的多样性。 CCDF 的未来版本将包含更多样化的视频长度（尤其是更长的视频，如果生成式模型的发展允许的话），并扩展动作类别的数量。

paragraphs.en: We propose CCDF a new dataset of generated videos that better represents real-world deepfakes by focusing on surveillance footage which is more likely to be used for malicious purposes and only uses recent commercial generators. The results of our benchmark demonstrate the inability of current detection methods to distinguish generated video from real video, despite their good performance on other datasets. This shows that current state-of-the-art open-source detectors can not be used in real-world scenarios and the difficulty in protecting users from generated content using automated approaches. A likely reason behind the failure of these detector models is the data used to train and evaluate them, as they all perform well on other datasets which focus on benign content and older generative methods. This highlights two important challenges: (1) the need for more difficult generated video datasets representing more malicious attacks and (2) the need for detection methods that are more resilient to zero-shot detection on recent methods. With CCDF, we make one step towards solving the first challenge and we hope that its release will help the deepfake detection community solve the second challenge. Future works will focus on improving CCDF to better represent the quality and diversity of malicious deepfakes used in real scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CCDF，一个由生成视频组成的新数据集。该数据集通过聚焦于更可能用于恶意目的的监控录像，并仅使用近期的商业生成工具，从而更好地反映了现实世界中的深度伪造内容。 我们的基准测试结果表明，尽管现有检测方法在其他数据集上表现良好，但它们却无法区分生成视频与真实视频。 这表明，当前最先进的开源检测器无法在现实场景中应用，同时凸显了利用自动化方法保护用户免受生成内容侵害的难度。 这些检测模型失效的一个可能原因，在于用于训练和评估它们的数据集：它们在其他专注于良性内容和旧有生成方法的 dataset 上表现良好。 这凸显出两个重要挑战：（1）需要更具挑战性、能反映更恶意攻击的生成视频数据集；（2）需要能够更有效地对抗近期生成方法的零样本检测的检测手段。 借助 CCDF，我们朝着解决第一个挑战迈出了第一步，并希望其发布能帮助深度伪造检测领域解决第二个挑战。 未来的工作将聚焦于改进 CCDF，使其能更好地体现现实场景中使用的恶意深度伪造内容在质量与多样性上的特征。

sents.en: We propose CCDF a new dataset of generated videos that better represents real-world deepfakes by focusing on surveillance footage which is more likely to be used for malicious purposes and only uses recent commercial generators.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 CCDF，一个由生成视频组成的新数据集。该数据集通过聚焦于更可能用于恶意目的的监控录像，并仅使用近期的商业生成工具，从而更好地反映了现实世界中的深度伪造内容。

sents.en: The results of our benchmark demonstrate the inability of current detection methods to distinguish generated video from real video, despite their good performance on other datasets.
sents.zh: 我们的基准测试结果表明，尽管现有检测方法在其他数据集上表现良好，但它们却无法区分生成视频与真实视频。

sents.en: This shows that current state-of-the-art open-source detectors can not be used in real-world scenarios and the difficulty in protecting users from generated content using automated approaches.
sents.zh: 这表明，当前最先进的开源检测器无法在现实场景中应用，同时凸显了利用自动化方法保护用户免受生成内容侵害的难度。

sents.en: A likely reason behind the failure of these detector models is the data used to train and evaluate them, as they all perform well on other datasets which focus on benign content and older generative methods.
sents.zh: 这些检测模型失效的一个可能原因，在于用于训练和评估它们的数据集：它们在其他专注于良性内容和旧有生成方法的 dataset 上表现良好。

sents.en: This highlights two important challenges: (1) the need for more difficult generated video datasets representing more malicious attacks and (2) the need for detection methods that are more resilient to zero-shot detection on recent methods.
sents.zh: 这凸显出两个重要挑战：（1）需要更具挑战性、能反映更恶意攻击的生成视频数据集；（2）需要能够更有效地对抗近期生成方法的零样本检测的检测手段。

sents.en: With CCDF, we make one step towards solving the first challenge and we hope that its release will help the deepfake detection community solve the second challenge.
sents.zh: 借助 CCDF，我们朝着解决第一个挑战迈出了第一步，并希望其发布能帮助深度伪造检测领域解决第二个挑战。

sents.en: Future works will focus on improving CCDF to better represent the quality and diversity of malicious deepfakes used in real scenarios.
sents.zh: 未来的工作将聚焦于改进 CCDF，使其能更好地体现现实场景中使用的恶意深度伪造内容在质量与多样性上的特征。

paragraphs.en: In this section we present the effect of the different modification made to create the Cleaned set from the raw set. For each experiment only one feature was modified from the raw set. Table 19(d) shows the results after the framerate of every video is set to 24fps. We observe that this has no real effect on image based approaches while only Waverep is significantly affected among the video-based methods. In Table 20(d) , we present results after the resolution of video is mirrored from real videos. Here we observe a consistent drop in performance indicating that methods rely in part on difference in resolution to classify videos. In Table 21(d) , we show the effect of mirroring the bitrate form real videos. Here, we observe that some methods (e.g BFREE) are not affected while other like C-Forensics or WaveRep show a large drop in performance which indicate that some models rely more strongly on global image quality in their decision. Additionally we present in Table 22(d) the effect on using video of different duration for real and generated samples. We observe We do not observe any significant change in performance here. While this is unsurprising for the image based methods, it indicates that video duration biases do not affect video-based detection methods. Overall we see that both image and video-based methods are mostly affected by biases in resolution and bitrate that are related to image quality. This is likely related to the training data as most commonly used datasets contains very large difference in resolutions between real and generated videos.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们展示了为从原始数据集创建“清洗后”数据集而进行的不同修改所产生的影响。 在每次实验中，仅对原始数据集中的一个特征进行了修改。 表 19(d) 显示了将每个视频的帧率设为 24fps 后的结果。 我们观察到，这对基于图像的方法没有实际影响，而在基于视频的方法中，只有 Waverep 受到了显著影响。 在表 20(d) 中，我们展示了将视频分辨率从真实视频中镜像后的结果。 此处我们观察到性能持续下降，表明这些方法在一定程度上依赖分辨率差异来对视频进行分类。 在表 21(d) 中，我们展示了将比特率从真实视频中镜像所产生的影响。 在此，我们观察到某些方法（例如 BFREE）未受影响，而 C-Forensics 或 WaveRep 等方法则表现出性能大幅下降，这表明部分模型在决策过程中更依赖全局图像质量。 此外，我们在表 22(d) 中展示了为真实样本和生成样本使用不同时长视频所产生的影响。 我们观察到此处性能没有发生任何显著变化。 尽管这对基于图像的方法而言并不意外，但结果表明视频时长的偏差并未影响基于视频的检测方法。 总体而言，我们看到基于图像和基于视频的方法主要受到与图像质量相关的分辨率和比特率偏差的影响。 这很可能与训练数据有关，因为大多数常用数据集的真实视频与生成视频之间的分辨率差异非常大。

sents.zh: 表 19(d) 显示了将每个视频的帧率设为 24fps 后的结果。

sents.en: We observe that this has no real effect on image based approaches while only Waverep is significantly affected among the video-based methods.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，这对基于图像的方法没有实际影响，而在基于视频的方法中，只有 Waverep 受到了显著影响。

sents.en: In Table 20(d) , we present results after the resolution of video is mirrored from real videos.
sents.zh: 在表 20(d) 中，我们展示了将视频分辨率从真实视频中镜像后的结果。

sents.en: Here we observe a consistent drop in performance indicating that methods rely in part on difference in resolution to classify videos.
sents.zh: 此处我们观察到性能持续下降，表明这些方法在一定程度上依赖分辨率差异来对视频进行分类。

sents.en: In Table 21(d) , we show the effect of mirroring the bitrate form real videos.
sents.zh: 在表 21(d) 中，我们展示了将比特率从真实视频中镜像所产生的影响。

sents.en: Here, we observe that some methods (e.g BFREE) are not affected while other like C-Forensics or WaveRep show a large drop in performance which indicate that some models rely more strongly on global image quality in their decision.
sents.zh: 在此，我们观察到某些方法（例如 BFREE）未受影响，而 C-Forensics 或 WaveRep 等方法则表现出性能大幅下降，这表明部分模型在决策过程中更依赖全局图像质量。

sents.en: Additionally we present in Table 22(d) the effect on using video of different duration for real and generated samples.
sents.zh: 此外，我们在表 22(d) 中展示了为真实样本和生成样本使用不同时长视频所产生的影响。

sents.en: We observe We do not observe any significant change in performance here.
sents.zh: 我们观察到此处性能没有发生任何显著变化。

sents.en: While this is unsurprising for the image based methods, it indicates that video duration biases do not affect video-based detection methods.
sents.zh: 尽管这对基于图像的方法而言并不意外，但结果表明视频时长的偏差并未影响基于视频的检测方法。

sents.en: Overall we see that both image and video-based methods are mostly affected by biases in resolution and bitrate that are related to image quality.
sents.zh: 总体而言，我们看到基于图像和基于视频的方法主要受到与图像质量相关的分辨率和比特率偏差的影响。

sents.en: This is likely related to the training data as most commonly used datasets contains very large difference in resolutions between real and generated videos.
sents.zh: 这很可能与训练数据有关，因为大多数常用数据集的真实视频与生成视频之间的分辨率差异非常大。
